name: Education Administration
description: Starter pack for school and academy administration: term cycles, exams, reporting, accreditation and safety.

definitions.title: Daily attendance reconciliation
definitions.note: Reconcile class attendance records and follow up unexplained absences.

definitions.title: Weekly staff meeting preparation
definitions.note: Prepare the agenda and minutes for the weekly staff meeting.

definitions.title: Weekly parent newsletter
definitions.note: Send the weekly newsletter to parents.

definitions.title: Monthly fire drill
definitions.note: Run the monthly fire drill and file the record.

definitions.title: Monthly report card cycle check
definitions.note: Check teacher grade entry progress against the report card deadline.

definitions.title: Quarterly exam schedule preparation
definitions.note: Prepare exam timetables, rooms and invigilators.
steps: Publish the schedule to staff and families

definitions.title: Quarterly curriculum review with teachers
definitions.note: Review curriculum pacing with teaching staff.

definitions.title: Accreditation evidence collection
definitions.note: Collect the annual evidence set for accreditation.

definitions.title: Teacher contract renewals
definitions.note: Renew teacher contracts for the next school year.

definitions.title: Enrolment intake preparation
definitions.note: Prepare enrolment intake: forms, assessments and orientation schedule.

definitions.title: Emergency plan review
definitions.note: Review the emergency plan and contact lists before the new year.

definitions.title: Ad-hoc student incident documentation
definitions.note: Document a student incident and follow-ups - set the due date when creating it.
